items.title: De'Von Achane: Not playing Saturday
items.description:
Achane is not in uniform for Saturday's preseason game against the Giants, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

items.title: Isaiah Bond: Getting checked for possible concussion
items.description:
Bond is being evaluated for a possible concussion and is questionable to return to Saturday's preseason game against the Bills.

items.title: Jayden Daniels: Rusty in first game
items.description:
Daniels did not complete his sole pass attempt and took a 10-yard sack in Saturday's 17-13 preseason loss to the Lions.
